Name: I Dig It
Description: A physics-based digging adventure: pilot your excavator ever deeper underground across the Farm, Cavern, Oceanic, Antarctic, Amazonian and Egyptian expeditions, collecting valuable Diggins and rare artifacts, plugging vents, discharging gas pockets and upgrading your rig along the way.

Achievements.Name: Junk Collector
Achievements.Description: Complete your collection of the junk diggins from the Farm.

Achievements.Name: Historian
Achievements.Description: Complete your collection of artifacts from the Antarctic.

Achievements.Name: Pirateologist
Achievements.Description: Complete your collection of pirate artifacts from the Oceanic expedition.

Achievements.Name: Aztecologist
Achievements.Description: Complete your collection of Aztec artifacts from the Amazonian expedition.

Achievements.Name: Mushroom Farmer
Achievements.Description: Collect 100 mushrooms from the Cavern expedition.

Achievements.Name: Egyptologist
Achievements.Description: Complete your collection of Egyptian artifacts.

Achievements.Name: Venting
Achievements.Description: Plug 10 geothermal vents in the Oceanic expedition.

Achievements.Name: Entomologist
Achievements.Description: Collect 30 small ants and 10 large ants from the Amazonian expedition.

Achievements.Name: Meet the Team
Achievements.Description: Find all of the Developer tokens.
